text: In accordance with Section 9A of the Consolidated Rules of Procedure for the Property Standards Committee, as amended, each Panel shall adopt a schedule of meetings to hear appeals for each year. Please note that meetings for the Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel, will be held remotely until further notice.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel, approved the following meeting date for 2026: Tuesday, February 24, 2026 Tuesday, March 31, 2026 Tuesday, April 28, 2026 Tuesday, May 26, 2026 Tuesday, June 30, 2026 Tuesday, July 28, 2026 Tuesday, September 29, 2026 Tuesday, October 27, 2026 Tuesday, November 24, 2026 Tuesday, December 15, 2026
